'''Lancer4life QMC My Way''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lancer4life]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 QMC Lancer4life LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Same ol' same ol'

The published list has 58 cards.
